name: Glacier National Park
note: Glacier National Park in BC; GeoNames lists it only as Glacier National Park of Canada, so this name points there. There is also a Glacier National Park in Montana

name: Columbia River
note: one river that flows through BC and the US; GeoNames gives it only the US, with no second country

name: Rocky Mountains
note: the Rocky Mountains of North America run through BC; GeoNames codes them US with Canada as a second country, but their GeoNames point is in Wyoming, too far from BC for the second-country rule

name: Cascade Range
note: the Cascade Range runs from northern California through Washington into southern BC; GeoNames gives the Washington entry only the US, with no second country
